current.title: The Golden Rickshaw
current.logline: A struggling rickshaw driver finds a forgotten pouch of heavy gold coins, setting off a city-wide chase where every passenger tests his integrity.

parts.title: Will a lost fortune change everything? | Pt 1/3
parts.hook_text: Who left this heavy leather pouch behind?
parts.description: Jin discovers a mysterious leather pouch filled with glowing gold coins in his rickshaw, leading to a tense confrontation under the neon lights of Neo-Shanghai.
parts.caption: Who left this heavy leather pouch behind? Part 1/3 — save this so you don't miss the next part. Would you return the glowing gold or keep it?

parts.title: A stolen fortune or a family saved? | Pt 2/3
parts.hook_text: This gold buys us a new life.
parts.previously: Jin finds a pouch of heavy gold coins under a streetlamp.
parts.description: Madam Wong offers Jin half the gold to stay quiet, but Jin discovers the truth about the coins.
parts.caption: This gold buys us a new life. Part 2/3 — save this so you don't miss the next part. Would you keep the stolen gold? #NeoShanghai #TheGoldenRickshaw #Comics #Choice

panels.image_prompt: Dark neon alleyway, Jin holding a pouch of gleaming gold coins while Madam Wong stands close by, medium shot, upper 25% empty brick wall, sharp contrast lighting, tense emotion.
panels.narration: Madam Wong whispers a dangerous offer in the shadows.

dialogue.speaker: Madam Wong
dialogue.line: This gold buys us a new life. Take half and stay quiet.

panels.image_prompt: Close-up of Jin holding a heavy gold coin in a dark alleyway, upper 25% empty dark sky, low angle, neon glow lighting, hesitant emotion.

dialogue.line: Half of this pays our rent for ten years.

panels.narration: The crest belongs to the city children's home.

dialogue.speaker: Jin
dialogue.line: These coins belong to the orphanage fund.

dialogue.speaker: Madam Wong
dialogue.line: The kids won't even know it is gone. Think of your family.

panels.image_prompt: Jin staring at his empty rickshaw handles with a troubled face, upper 25% empty sky, over-the-shoulder shot, cold blue lighting, conflicted emotion.
panels.narration: Visions of empty plates clash with the faces of hungry children.

panels.narration: Madam Wong blocks the only way out of the dark alley.

dialogue.speaker: Madam Wong
dialogue.line: Choose wisely, driver. Walk away rich, or walk away broke.

panels.image_prompt: Jin gripping his rickshaw handles tightly, caught between the gold and the exit, upper 25% empty sky, low angle, dramatic contrast lighting, impossible choice emotion.

parts.caption: This gold belongs to the children! Part 3/3 — save this so you don't miss the next part. Would you return the gold?

beats.summary: Jin finds a heavy leather pouch stuffed with glowing gold coins left in his rickshaw after dropping off a mysterious wealthy passenger.
beats.cliffhanger: Jin unzips the pouch to find the gold gleaming under a neon streetlamp, right as Madam Wong steps out of the shadows, claiming the money is hers.
beats.payoff_next: Jin holds the pouch tightly against his chest while Madam Wong steps closer with an outstretched hand.

beats.summary: Madam Wong offers Jin half the gold if he keeps quiet, but doubts begin to eat at him as he realizes the coins belong to the city's orphanage fund.
beats.cliffhanger: Madam Wong blocks the alley exit, forcing Jin to choose between keeping the wealth to save his struggling family or returning the stolen funds to the children.
beats.payoff_next: Jin steps past Madam Wong, gripping the handles of his rickshaw and turning away from the gleaming gold.

beats.summary: Jin pedals the rickshaw directly to the orphanage gates, handing back the exact pouch of gold, and discovers that honesty brings a true reward far greater than riches.
